integrity: The proof uses the published forward-confluence condition directly, derives an iff row-normal form, and then counts all allowed fibers through a Gaussian-binomial identity. All binary relations are exhaustively checked through four worlds, and the closed formula is independently evaluated at larger sizes. The recent primary full text and the original FIK paper were compared for chain enumeration and equivalent structural statements; none was located.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is an exact labelled-frame census for the case where the intuitionistic preorder is a finite chain. It does not enumerate FIK relations on arbitrary finite posets, quotient frames by logical equivalence, or provide a complexity lower bound for FIK validity.
title: Gaussian-binomial census of FIK relations on finite chains
